questions.question: What is the diameter of the circle representing the top view of a cone with an 80 mm base diameter?

explanations.explanation: The top view of a cone shows its base as a circle with the same diameter as the base.

questions.question: Which of the following solids has an equal and regular rectangle as its faces?

explanations.explanation: A prism has identical and regular rectangular faces along its length.

questions.question: For a triangular prism resting on its base on HP, what is the shape of its base in the top view?

explanations.explanation: When viewed from the top, the base of a triangular prism appears as a triangle.

questions.question: What is the shape of the base of a regular tetrahedron?

explanations.explanation: A regular tetrahedron has all four faces as equilateral triangles, including the base.

questions.question: In a hexagonal prism, if the axis is inclined at 45° to the HP, what is the shape of its base in the top view?

explanations.explanation: The top view always shows the true shape of the base, which is a hexagon for a hexagonal prism.

questions.question: What is the axis of a right solid when it is inclined to both HP and VP?

answers.b: Inclined to HP and parallel to VP
answers.c: Inclined to both HP and VP
answers.d: Parallel to both HP and VP

explanations.c: Inclined to both HP and VP
explanations.explanation: If a solid is tilted with respect to both reference planes, its axis is inclined to both HP and VP.

questions.question: In the procedure for drawing a cone, what does the circle in the top view represent?

explanations.explanation: The circle in the top view of a cone represents the base of the cone.

questions.question: What is the axis of a right cone when it is parallel to both HP and VP?

answers.d: Parallel to both HP and VP

explanations.d: Parallel to both HP and VP
explanations.explanation: When a cone’s axis is parallel to both reference planes, it lies horizontally in space.

questions.question: Which type of projection involves a solid resting on one of its faces in HP with its vertical faces equally inclined to VP?

explanations.explanation: Axonometric projection allows multiple faces of a 3D object to be shown simultaneously in a single view.

questions.question: What is the position of the axis in a cone resting on one of its generators on HP?

answers.a: Perpendicular to HP and parallel to VP
answers.b: Perpendicular to VP and parallel to HP
answers.c: Inclined to both HP and VP
answers.d: Parallel to both HP and VP

explanations.c: Inclined to both HP and VP
explanations.explanation: When a cone rests on a generator, its axis is slanted, thus inclined to both HP and VP.
